summary: Practise event controls, entitlement checks and settlement exception handling. Explore the five-day corporate actions course and its operational curriculum.
lede: Corporate actions processing and settlement training is for intermediate custody, asset-servicing and settlement professionals managing securities events through final posting. It develops practical control of event classification and deadlines, entitlement checks and voluntary elections, plus cash and securities reconciliation and exception handling. Using event records, position data, ISO message examples and Excel working papers, participants create event controls, verify calculations and document handoffs without needing message coding or production-system configuration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who process, supervise or control securities events and their downstream cash and position movements. It suits intermediate practitioners with working exposure to custody, asset servicing, settlement or investment operations.
modules: ISO Message Flow for Event Operations
prerequisites: Working knowledge of securities operations, custody, asset servicing or post-trade processing is expected. Spreadsheet familiarity is useful for the entitlement and exception exercises. Coding or programming is not required; the course uses operational message examples rather than message-system configuration.
